description: Link your own purchases’ on-chain purchase proofs to your X (Twitter) account, so a post of yours can be checked against the chain. Buyer’s X account (self-declared): the buyer linked this purchase to their own X account; GYOTAK has not checked that the account belongs to the buyer. Each stamped purchase comes with the URL of its public verification page. Only works through a personal token URL connector — there is no customerKey argument. Called with no arguments it only lists the purchases that can be linked and links nothing, every time — pass handle to actually link. A link is stamped on chain and cannot be undone, so let the user pick the handle before you pass one. Automatic binding of future purchases is off by default: to turn it on, pass handle with auto_bind "on" — the first such call returns the consent text; show it to the user word for word (the text is in Japanese and English; show both), and only if they agree call again with consent true. Pass auto_bind "off" to stop it (no handle needed); only later purchases stop, anything already recorded stays.

auto_bind.description: Turn automatic binding of future purchases to your X handle on or off. "on" needs handle and consent. "off" needs nothing else. Omit to leave the setting as it is.

consent.description: Set true only when the user has read the consent text returned by an earlier auto_bind "on" call and agreed to it. Never set it on your own.

handle.description: Your X handle without the leading @ (letters, digits and underscore, 1-15 characters). Required to link: a call without it only lists your purchases and links nothing, even if you linked before. Pass it on every link.

purchase_id.description: Link only this purchase (e.g. "PB-20260917-a97953d3"). Omit to link every purchase of yours that is not linked yet.

name: claim_purchase_proof
